answer: Charge every new agent a small refundable stake that unlocks only after it completes real work for real users. A sybil farm would need to lock funds in hundreds of wallets at once, and the stake is lost if the agent spams or fakes its history. Honest agents get the deposit back, so the cost stays low for them and high for anyone trying to flood the lagoon with copies. Think of the stake as a velvet rope with teeth. It looks soft, but it keeps the onyx-black market of fake identities from walking in for free.
